subject: Post-demo cost sync + procurement lane (monthly spend bands)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Burns <alex.burns@brightfield.ai>
Cc: Monika Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo cost sync + procurement lane (monthly spend bands)

Alex — thanks again for the demo today. Quick follow-up to capture what we discussed and a narrow ask so we can align procurement and pricing.

Short recap (from our side):
- Brightfield's primary use is high-concurrency customer-facing chat (avg. 240 tokens per session) with peak 6k sessions/day.
- Team expects 40k–120k sessions/mo in the initial 6 months while running A/B experiments.
- Target per-customer latency requirement ~250ms p50 for the inference path.

Cost/pricing items we need to validate:
1) Estimated monthly token volumes: you mentioned ~9–30M tokens/day (bursty). We need a conservative monthly band to size Dedicated capacity or commit. Please confirm low/nominal/high monthly token estimates (tokens/month).
2) Target unit economics: you called out wanting to keep model spend to ~$40–$120 / 1M tokens. Confirm the target $/1M tokens and whether that is including or excluding infra+support.
3) Procurement thresholds: does Brightfield require a PO for any monthly spend > $25k? Or is the procurement gate $50k/month? Any lead times we should account for (legal/finance signoff cadence)?

Action requested from you by EOD Thu (21 May):
- One-line answers to the three items above (monthly token band, target $/1M tokens, PO threshold/lead time).
- If possible, attach a simple burn projection or share an internal doc.

We attached a short worksheet with scenario buckets (Brightfield_Monthly_Burn_Scenarios.xlsx) that shows how different token bands map to monthly spend under our public unit rates and dedicated discounts. Also attaching our standard procurement lanes doc for PO thresholds.

Next steps on our side once we have that:
- We'll propose two procurement paths: a Pilot commit (monthly commit + overage) sized to your low/nominal band, and a Reserved pool option sized to nominal/high band with reserved discounts.
- If PO > threshold, we'll loop Legal and Finance and prepare an SOW draft.

Thanks again — cc'ing Monica and Marissa to help with procurement playbook and to prep pricing scenarios.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Alex Burns <alex.burns@brightfield.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightfield.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monika Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo cost sync + procurement lane (monthly spend bands)

Thanks Karthik — good summary. Answers inline: 

1) Monthly token band (low / nominal / high):
- Low: 300M tokens/month
- Nominal: 900M tokens/month
- High: 2.7B tokens/month (we expect spikes during launches)

2) Target unit economics: we are aiming for $60 / 1M tokens delivered (this should include all model and inference spend but excludes SRE support and professional services). If you have a bundled committed discount, please show net $/1M under both Pilot and Reserved options.

3) Procurement thresholds: internal procurement requires a PO for any monthly spend >= $30k. Typical legal + finance review time is ~3 weeks; procurement lead time 5 business days after PO.

Attached a quick internal burn matrix (not formal). Happy to hop on a 20m call if you want to run numbers together.

Alex
Alex Burns
Director of Product
Brightfield AI
alex.burns@brightfield.ai

Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement lane details + PO thresholds (re: Brightfield)

Alex / team — quick procurement note from our side based on your answers. Happy to discuss but wanted to put the lane + timing on record so expectations are clear.

1) If Brightfield lands in the Low band (~300M tokens/month):
- We recommend a 3-month Pilot commit with a monthly commit sized to 300M tokens (we'll show equivalent $/1M after discount).
- PO not strictly required for Pilot (can run on card for the first 30 days) but a PO accelerates SSO/enterprise onboarding.

2) Nominal band (~900M tokens/month):
- Best fit for Reserved pool (1–3 month ramp). Procurement: PO required if expected monthly invoice >= $30k.
- If you want contract-level SLAs, Legal review is standard (2–3 weeks).

3) High band (2.7B tokens/month):
- This is an Enterprise engagement. We'll need an SOW + committed reserved capacity; PO and an annual contract preferred. Procurement lead time generally 3–4 weeks.

Pricing note: with a nominal Reserved commitment we can show an effective model+infra blended rate of ~$45–55 / 1M tokens depending on quantization and batching profile. For Pilots (month-to-month) expect ~$70–$85 / 1M. We'll model exact values once we have a confirmed nominal token band and latency profile.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Thresholds.pdf (short procurement lane summary).

If Brightfield confirms the nominal band by EOW, we can turn around a pilot commitment proposal within 48–72 hours.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
